points: Boil a full kettle. Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ½ tsp salt on high heat.
Add the rigatoni and bring back to the boil. Cook until tender, 12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and pop back in the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Pasta Time

points: While the pasta cooks, heat a large frying pan on medium-high heat (no oil).
Once hot, add the beef and pork mince and fry until browned, 5-6 mins. Use a spoon to break it up as it cooks.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince.

steps.title: Fry the Beef and Pork

points: While the beef and pork cooks, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Trim and thinly slice the spring onion.
steps.title: Grate and Slice

points: When the mince has browned, drain and discard any excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the mushrooms to the beef and pork and stir-fry until browned, 3-4 mins.
Lower the pan to medium heat, then add the garlic and tomato puree. Cook for 1 min.
Stir through the gochujang paste, creme fraiche, chicken stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts). Simmer until thickened slightly, 3-4 mins.

notes.text: The mince is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Get the Gochujang

points: Add the spinach to the pan a handful at a time until wilted and piping hot, 1-2 mins.
Stir the butter (see pantry for amount) into the sauce until melted.
Stir through the cooked rigatoni, then taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
steps.title: All Together Now

points: Share the creamy gochujang rigatoni between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the spring onion to finish.
steps.title: Serve Up
